stops.name: Hochfeiler
stops.quote: Surrounded by numerous peaks over 3,000 metres – with the Hochfeiler as the highest summit – the valley is considered the birthplace of Alpine mountaineering.
stops.english: Surrounded by numerous peaks over 3,000 metres – with the Hochfeiler as the highest summit – the valley is considered the birthplace of Alpine mountaineering.

stops.name: Actionberg Penken
stops.quote: Those seeking a sporting challenge cannot miss Actionberg Penken.
stops.english: Those seeking a sporting challenge cannot miss Actionberg Penken.

stops.name: Harakiri run
stops.quote: Here, Austria's steepest ski slope awaits the bravest: the legendary Harakiri run with up to 78% gradient.
stops.english: Here, Austria's steepest ski slope awaits the bravest: the legendary Harakiri run with up to 78% gradient.

stops.name: Spieljoch
stops.quote: The small ski area at Spieljoch is particularly family-friendly, featuring a fun park, fun slope, toboggan run, and wide pistes.
stops.english: The small ski area at Spieljoch is particularly family-friendly, featuring a fun park, fun slope, toboggan run, and wide pistes.

stops.name: Arena Coaster
stops.quote: Speeding downhill for 1,500 metres with exciting curves and steep sections.
stops.english: Speeding downhill for 1,500 metres with exciting curves and steep sections.

stops.name: Fichtenschloss
stops.quote: Located in Zell am Ziller, Fichtenschloss is an adventure playground made of spruce wood, featuring several towers and offering a great view of the surrounding area.
stops.english: Located in Zell am Ziller, Fichtenschloss is an adventure playground made of spruce wood, featuring several towers and offering a great view of the surrounding area.

stops.name: Nature Ice Palace
stops.quote: Visitors explore impressive ice formations, stalactites, and a frozen waterfall.
stops.english: Visitors explore impressive ice formations, stalactites, and a frozen waterfall.

stops.name: Hintertux Glacier
stops.quote: In winter, the Zillertal in Tirol transforms into a true skier’s paradise: over 540 km of slopes, modern cable cars and the Hintertux Glacier guarantee snow fun at altitudes of up to 3,250 metres.
stops.english: In winter, the Zillertal in Tirol transforms into a true skier’s paradise: over 540 km of slopes, modern cable cars and the Hintertux Glacier guarantee snow fun at altitudes of up to 3,250 metres.

stops.name: Zillertal High Road
stops.quote: This picturesque panoramic road winds through the stunning mountain landscape of the Zillertal, providing breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks.
stops.english: This picturesque panoramic road winds through the stunning mountain landscape of the Zillertal, providing breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks.

stops.name: Zillertal Railway
stops.quote: The historic Zillertal Railway connects Mayrhofen with Jenbach, offering a nostalgic ride through the valley.
stops.english: The historic Zillertal Railway connects Mayrhofen with Jenbach, offering a nostalgic ride through the valley.
